column1: # The 19 LS4 failure states logged in results/k4_ls4_4_sample.log (LS4, default rule, 100,000 random profiles per pure
# n = 4 core). LS4 failed on 20 profiles; the log prints at most 5 failures per core and one core with m = 7 had 6, so 19

# pool U as a hex mask; LS4 trajectory (states after each move, bundles as hex masks, separated by commas);
